neighbours.label: advice to be an informed buyer: researching, checking or knowing what you purchase or choose
fire: Before choosing a contractor, compare quotes and read customer reviews.
Always check the safety ratings before you buy a used car seat.
Shoppers should know exactly what they purchase and where it comes from.
Research the warranty terms and repair records before ordering a fridge.
Look up the seller's ratings and return policy before you pay.
Make an informed choice by comparing insurance plans side by side.
Ask questions and read the fine print before signing for a loan.
Find out what the ingredients are before you buy a supplement.
quiet: The contractor arrived early and finished the kitchen by noon.
She bought a used car seat at the market on Saturday.
Shoppers crowded the mall on the first day of the holiday sale.
The fridge was delivered on Tuesday and fits the kitchen well.
He paid at the counter and carried the bags to his car.
Their insurance plan covers dental care for the whole family.
The bank approved the loan and the couple moved in last spring.
The supplement comes in a small green bottle with a white cap.
